messages:
Aisha (Billing): FYI Veridian flagged a $2,400 charge on invoice 11088 that should have been a partner pass-through (vendor billed twice). Can we issue a refund?
Daniel (Account Exec): Confirmed with partner: they invoiced us but did not provision; partner issued credit to us on 2026-05-02 but it wasn’t applied. Need manual refund to customer.
Aisha (Billing): Invoice snippet: ```
Invoice: 11088
Customer: Veridian (US)
Charge: Partner integration fee $2,400.00
Applied credits: none
Total: $2,400.00
```
Priya (Head of Billing): What's the source document showing partner credit to Redwood?
Daniel (Account Exec): Uploaded partner_credit_20260502.pdf and partner_email_thread.eml to the ticket.
Aisha (Billing): billing-bot, draft credit memo CM-2026-501 for $2,400. Reason: partner double-bill pass-through refund. Tag: veridian-partner-2026.
billing-bot: Draft created 1 CM-2026-501 for $2,400.00 (status: DRAFT). Attachments: partner_credit_20260502.pdf.
Priya (Head of Billing): Tax check before approval. tax-bot, is this taxable?
tax-bot: Pass-through refund of a previously billed vendor charge to US customer is typically non-taxable adjustment. Confirmed for Veridian (state: CA).
Priya (Head of Billing): Approving up to $5k for partner pass-through corrections. billing-bot, move CM-2026-501 to APPROVED and apply to invoice 11088. Add memo: "Approved per pass-through reconciliation; see partner_credit_20260502.pdf."
billing-bot: CM-2026-501 moved to APPROVED and applied to Invoice 11088. New invoice balance: $0.00. Journal: CRD-2026-501 posted, revops notified.
Daniel (Account Exec): Notified customer via support ticket; they responded: "Thanks, that clears it up."
Aisha (Billing): Closing the ticket and attaching CM paperwork to May month-end bundle. Notifying partners team to reconcile their billing feed.
